import Aesop

theorem dyadic_weighted_binomial_normalization (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (Finset.prod (Finset.range 7) (fun k : ℕ =>
      (2 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ k) + (3 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ k))) *
      (Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) (fun k : ℕ => k * Nat.choose n k)) =
    ((3 : ℕ) ^ 128 - (2 : ℕ) ^ 128) * (n * 2 ^ (n - 1)) := by
  have hsum :
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) (fun k : ℕ => k * Nat.choose n k) =
        n * 2 ^ (n - 1) := by
    have hterm : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n,
        k * Nat.choose n k = n * Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) := by
      intro k hk
      have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).1
      have h := Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq (n - 1) (k - 1)
      rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel
        (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hn))] at h
      rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hk1] at h
      simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using h.symm
  
    have hsum' :
        Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun j => Nat.choose (n - 1) j) =
          2 ^ (n - 1) := by
      simpa [Nat.sub_add_cancel
        (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hn))] using
        (Nat.sum_range_choose (n - 1))
  
    calc
      _ = Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k => n * Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm
      _ = n * Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n)
          (fun k => Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1)) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = n * Finset.sum (Finset.range n)
          (fun j => Nat.choose (n - 1) j) := by
        congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_bij (fun k _ => k - 1)
        · intro k hk
          have hk' := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk
          simp only [Finset.mem_range]
          omega
        · intro a ha b hb hab
          have ha' := Finset.mem_Icc.mp ha
          have hb' := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hb
          omega
        · intro b hb
          have hb' : b < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hb
          refine ⟨b + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
            omega
          · omega
        · intro k hk
          rfl
      _ = n * 2 ^ (n - 1) := by
        rw [hsum']
  
  rw [hsum]
  norm_num [Finset.prod_range_succ]
